newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SACCHI SAYS VAN BASTEN COULD BE GREAT COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SACCHI SAYS VAN BASTEN COULD BE GREAT COACH.

text.p: Milan coach Arrigo Sacchi said on Thursday that his former Dutch player Marco Van Basten, forced out of the game by injury, would make a great coach just as compatriot Ruud Gullit had done in England.
Van Basten, with Gullit a leading member of Sacchi's Milan team in the late 1980s, turned up at Milan's Milanello training ground earlier for a short and solitary workout session.
After lunch and meeting some of his old team mates, the 33-year-old Dutch player left without comment.
"I was really moved, watching him play on his own, carrying himself on his injured ankles," said Sacchi.
"Van Basten was a player of extraordinary intelligence. In two years he could become a great coach.
"He must coach. I predicted that four of my players would have a career on the bench: him, Gullit, Ancelotti and Tassotti. The facts will prove me right," Sacchi declared.
Gullit is manager of English premier league club Chelsea, Carlo Ancelotti is coaching Parma who are second in serie A while Mauro Tassotti recently retired from Milan.
Van Basten, FIFA's player of the year in 1992, won three league titles and two European Cups with Milan before a persistent ankle injury forced him to retire in 1995.
He spent a day with Gullit's Chelsea last November, training for fun with his friend but ruling out any comeback.
